 Dated this the 13th day of September, 2024  ORDER Petitioners have invoked the jurisdiction under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhitha, 2023 to quash all proceedings against them.

2. Petitioners are accused Nos. 1 to 3 in Crime No. 295/2024 of Venjaramoodu Police Station,
registered for the offences under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 66(D) of the Information Technology Act, 2000.
Second respondent is the defacto complainant.

3. According to the prosecution, the accused had cheated and collided an amount of Rs.1,21,300/-
and thereby committed the offences alleged.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned counsel for the respondent, apart from the learned Public Prosecutor.
The learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that the matter has been settled and hence the proceedings against the petitioners ought to be quashed.

It was also submitted that, considering the Akhil V vs State Of Kerala on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173043586/
2 nature of offences alleged, no purpose would be served by continuing the proceedings.

sentences.text: I have perused Annexure A2 affidavit filed by the 2nd respondent.
The learned Public Prosecutor has submitted that upon verification, it is understood that the affidavit is genuine, and the defacto complainant stands by the contents thereof.
I am satisfied that the matter has been 2024:KER:70320 settled and no public interest is involved in this case.
There is no impediment for granting the prayer for quashing.
The continuance of the proceedings will only be an exercise in futility.

8. All proceedings against the petitioners in Crime No.295/2024 of Venjaramoodu Police Station,
are quashed.
This Crl.M.C is allowed as above.

Sd/-
